glosses: рейнский, относящийся к Рейнской области, происходящий из Рейнской области
auf das Rheinland und die Rheinländer bezogen
Of or pertaining to the Rhineland.
Any (or a group) of several language varieties found in a region on both sides of the Middle and Lower Rhine river in central western Germany, Belgium, the Netherlands, and Luxembourg.
The colloquial form of Standard German spoken in the Rhineland.
